entities.title: Regenerate the side-by-side page
entities.summary: After changing a test between // BEGIN <task-id> and // END <task-id> markers, regenerate docs/side-by-side.md.
entities.when: A UTV-first test inside task markers was added, changed or removed.
steps: From the repository root: python3 tools/side_by_side.py
Commit docs/side-by-side.md with the test change
entities.verify: python3 tools/side_by_side.py --check passes; CI fails when the page is out of date.
